fields.name: Audio
fields.description: Audio recording of the surface form pronunciation. Record directly or upload a file (max 1 MB).
fields.guidance: Keep recordings short: ≤3 seconds recommended, ≤5 seconds maximum. Pronounce the inflected form clearly (e.g., 'धावली' not the base form 'धावणे').

actions: Test playback to ensure the audio matches the inflected form
Verify the pronunciation sounds natural for that specific form
Add speaker and region metadata if needed
